top_stories.title: Meta Contractors Posed as Teens to Prompt Rival Chatbots About Suicide, Sex, and Drugs
top_stories.summary: Meta hired contractors who impersonated teenagers to prompt competitor chatbots with sensitive queries about suicide, sex, and drugs, according to Wired. The practice raises significant questions about AI ethics, competitive intelligence tactics, and content safety testing methods in the industry.

top_stories.title: OpenAI is teasing new hardware… for Codex
top_stories.summary: OpenAI has teased upcoming hardware designed specifically for its Codex AI coding product, hinting at a push into purpose-built AI infrastructure beyond software. The announcement suggests OpenAI is expanding its ambitions into the hardware space to support autonomous coding agents.

top_stories.title: AI agents are not your
top_stories.summary: MIT Technology Review examines the growing trend of companies framing AI agents as collaborative colleagues, arguing the analogy is misleading and potentially dangerous. The piece explores what distinguishes AI agents from human workers and the implications for how organisations deploy and trust these systems.

top_stories.title: Mapping Europe's AI Workforce Opportunity
top_stories.summary: OpenAI has published research mapping AI-related job transitions across the EU, identifying which roles and regions face the greatest disruption and opportunity from AI adoption. The report is framed as an assessment of how European workers can benefit from the AI economy.

top_stories.title: Grok 4.5 Undergoing Internal Testing at SpaceX and Tesla, Musk Says Performance May Exceed Claude Opus
top_stories.summary: Elon Musk announced that xAI's Grok 4.5 is being tested internally at SpaceX and Tesla, with Musk claiming it may match or exceed Anthropic's Claude Opus in performance. xAI also plans to release new models on a monthly cadence through the end of the year.

further_links.title: Agent confidence on the technical frontier
further_links.summary: MIT Technology Review explores how AI agents assess their own confidence levels when operating at the edge of their capabilities, with implications for reliability and deployment in high-stakes settings.

further_links.title: Lawmakers want to ban AI companies from selling your health data
further_links.summary: US senators Elizabeth Warren and others have proposed legislation that would prohibit AI companies from selling consumers' health and location data.

further_links.title: Tidal won't pay royalties on AI-generated music but isn't banning it outright
further_links.summary: Streaming platform Tidal has announced it will not pay royalties on AI-generated music tracks, while stopping short of an outright ban on such content on the platform.

further_links.title: Import AI 463: Self-improving robots; a 10k Chinese GPU cluster; and an elegiac essay for the human era
further_links.summary: Import AI's latest newsletter covers advances in self-improving robotics, a large-scale Chinese GPU cluster deployment, and a reflective essay on the implications of the current AI era for humanity.

further_links.title: This Humanoid Robot Is a Terrifyingly Competent Office Intern
further_links.summary: Wired profiles Flexion, a humanoid robot designed to perform office tasks, reporting it can handle a surprisingly broad range of real-world workplace activities with growing competence.

further_links.title: Elon Musk says SpaceX is putting top Starship and Starlink engineers to work on Grok
further_links.summary: Elon Musk has confirmed that senior engineering talent from SpaceX's Starship and Starlink programmes are being redirected to work on xAI's Grok, signalling a major internal resource commitment to the AI project.

further_links.title: French research thrown into turmoil by a multifaceted crisis
further_links.summary: French scientific research is facing a significant crisis driven by funding cuts, structural issues, and the pressures of AI integration, raising concerns about research integrity and the future of academic institutions in France.

further_links.title: Working With AI: A concrete example
further_links.summary: A detailed practical essay from htmx.org walks through a real-world example of collaborating with AI on a coding task, offering a grounded perspective on where AI coding tools help and where they fall short.
